decisions.reason: The candidate already requires an NTC terminal on J_BAT. Selecting a three-pin JST-PH connector that includes NTC does not change the thermal-monitoring requirement state.
The battery connector selection does not change the SK6812-based charge-status interface.
The connector family and pinout do not alter the existing AXP2101 electrical protection and cutoff rules.
The battery connector change does not affect the independently controlled 5V boost rail.
The selected connector family, pitch, and pinout do not themselves change the established battery-connector placement, orientation, or accessibility constraints.
The source concerns the battery connector and does not alter USB enumeration, data lines, or USB connector sourceability.
The battery connector specification does not change the addressable-LED family, power, or data interface.
The source does not revise the board dimensions, mounting arrangement, enclosure orientation, or connector-clearance requirement.
